title: Remove the obsolete no-hooks harness lane
body:
After the parser guard removal (krn-works/krn-codex-skills #463) the OpenCode plugin no longer intercepts tool calls, so the harness `no-hooks` lane in GLOBAL `scripts/harness/swebench-run.mjs:20` (with `brief: true`) exercises the same KRN surfaces as `full`, and `scripts/harness/opencode-agent.mjs:9` still describes the plugin as a guard (review round 2 of #463).
Acceptance: the harness either removes the `no-hooks` lane and its references or redefines it to disable a remaining component, with a test showing the lanes differ.
